about: RC4b derive: the byte pattern grammar, capture shapes, plan evaluation and the bundle. A new package; no previous law, property, example or test reads it.

mutants.name: rc4b-class-complement-drops-byte
mutants.rule: A complemented class is over all 256 bytes, as Go's regexp is on the same bytes (Pattern grammar 2).

mutants.name: rc4b-repeat-bound-off-by-one
mutants.from:
if v, ok := number(); ok {
			max = v
mutants.to:
if v, ok := number(); ok {
			max = v + 1
mutants.rule: {n,m} repeats n to m times (Pattern grammar 3).

mutants.name: rc4b-optional-as-required
mutants.rule: A capture that may not take part is an Option (Capture shapes 2).

mutants.name: rc4b-repeat-in-option-not-slice
mutants.rule: A capture under a repeat of more than one is a slice of every occurrence (Capture shapes 2).

mutants.name: rc4b-refine-strict-bound
mutants.rule: Refine(Of[B](), lo, hi) derives exactly `type N B where lo <= it && it <= hi` (Coherence 1).

mutants.name: rc4b-shadow-ignored
mutants.rule: A declaration in scope hides a predeclared constructor of the same name; calls key on values, never names (Derivation 6).

mutants.name: rc4b-step-budget-off
mutants.rule: A derive may take exactly the step, depth and size budgets and stops past them (Budgets 1).

mutants.name: rc4b-escape-offset-shift
mutants.rule: A pattern byte spelled by an escape is reported at the escape's backslash (Diagnostics 1).
